name: com.tgeindex/tgeindex
title: TGE Index
description: Token launches (TGEs) checked at the source: dates, tokenomics, unlocks, market makers, contracts.

tools.name: search_launches
tools.description: Search the TGE Index catalog of upcoming and recent token launches (TGEs). Every project is checked against its own official sources and scored on 8 disclosures (tokenomics, unlock schedule, float at TGE, market maker, venues, team or entity, audit, open incidents). Returns short records with the profile URL.

query.description: Name, ticker, chain or category words, e.g. "perp dex", "Base", "GEN".

status.description: upcoming = token not launched yet. Default any.

month.description: Only launches dated or scheduled in this month, YYYY-MM.

tools.name: get_launch
tools.description: Full TGE Index profile of one project: launch date or official window, all 8 checks with notes and source links, official contract addresses (only from the project's own posts or filings), airdrop status, and the dated history of changes.

project.description: Project name, ticker or slug, e.g. "infiniFi", "XTEN", "genlayer".

tools.name: launch_calendar
tools.description: Token launches for one month from the TGE Index catalog: launched, scheduled for a day, and those with only an official month or quarter window. Dates come from official sources only.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Dated changes across the TGE Index catalog, newest first: new projects, launches, moved or missed dates, score changes, each with its source.
